svg.title: Irradiate in the cooled sonication bath · sample A
svg.desc: Apply 40 kHz ultrasonic irradiation at 100 W output power for 7 h at room temperature. Flowing water cools the glass vessel in the bath. The source describes ambient pressure; no numerical room temperature, coolant settings or delivered acoustic intensity is supplied. Source-bound concept; apparatus geometry illustrative, not measured.
